prompts: Here is a URL (no save instruction)
Save this to Markdown; Notion is also available
destination.required: Explicit destination wins; established context can resolve omission; otherwise one concise destination question. Bare notes never initiate source sweeps. Bare URLs never authorize Zotero/Notion archive. No destination automatically writes elsewhere. Relevant mode only.

prompts: Append this private uncertain meeting note to my existing daily notes
Save a new note when no collection convention exists
markdown.required: Inspect collection, preserve naming/frontmatter/order and append-versus-create convention; preserve event uncertainty and distinguish local capture date. No taxonomy or unrelated rewrite. Read saved note back; concise receipt excludes private content.

prompts: Capture this supplied action in Second Brain
Gather last week's Gmail follow-ups into Second Brain
An existing row has the same source/action
The read is incomplete or only a placeholder Notion helper is available
Two unrelated ideas share a title
An email suggests commercial progress without an explicit new stage
secondbrain.required: Supplied input and explicitly scoped/time-bounded gathering enter one shared classify/deduplicate/write/verify process. Source availability gaps disclosed; no unsolicited sweep. Existing schema/properties/conservative values and Tasks/Deals/Ideas mapping preserved. Compare actual action/opportunity/idea and links, not title alone; no blind creation on incomplete reads. Supported clear-match update or ambiguous proposal. Verify configured operation support, prefer available connector, and give exact table/fields/values/existing identity manual proposals when unsupported. No indirect silent deal advancement, bulk bodies, Inbox or invented dates/owners; actual write read-back before success.

prompts: Save this video with only a machine transcript to Zotero
Save an article whose full text is inaccessible
Update notes on an existing canonical source without a supported writer
The connector returns SESSION_NOT_FOUND after import
research.required: Companion readiness and target selection; canonical dedup; missing/machine-source provenance and uncertainty; article access limits; grounded highlights and exact separate Raw_Transcript/Source_Outline plus Highlights notes. Prepare metadata/notes before one connector session, preserve tags, stop expired session without reimport. Unsupported updates prepare notes/blocker without duplicate. Verify saved parent and children, completeness and source anchors; no claimed unseen content or connector-only success.

routing.required: One entrypoint with three substantive destination modes; raw input and sweep share a Second Brain mode rather than four legacy wrappers. Helper/note-shape links resolve. Current callers route capture to knowledge-capture; interactions remain a separate explicit harness-capture-interactions tool. Notion API is unchanged and not presumed configured/capable.
